desc: This pixel art character is a solid bright green mannequin. The bright green colour is intentional (a chroma key) and must stay exactly the same bright green in every frame. Frame 1 already wears a simple grey steel knight helmet covering the top and sides of the head, face visible: copy exactly that design, colours and size onto the other frames. Add only a simple grey steel knight helmet covering the top and sides of the head, face visible, drawn in its own natural colours (no bright green on the item), identical design in all frames. Frames 2 onward, all facing east: 8 frames of a slash animation, then 6 frames of a cross-punch animation. Keep every other pixel, the pose, the outline and the transparent background unchanged.
